title: Submission (client -> lab transport body)
description: Body of POST /v0/submit (prototype transport HTTPS). Each envelope is verified on its own; one bad envelope never fails the others. The envelopes keep their per-site-key signatures; in v1 the same payloads travel one per OHTTP request with a token (auth.md).

request_id.description: Fresh random UUID per HTTP request; echoed as ack.in_reply_to.
